stemMd: Which statement best summarises the passage?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The plume certainly reached both lakes.

options.label: C
options.textMd: An absent geological trace may reflect preservation failure rather than absence of the original event.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Missing evidence can never support any inference.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Volcanic eruptions never deposit ash in lakes.

explanationMd: The passage offers two explanations for a missing layer and proposes evidence to distinguish them. Preservation conditions determine how strongly absence bears on the original event.

distractorRationale.d: The final sentence explicitly rejects that absolute view.
